//: Copy to config.json. Every key is optional; PRIVATE_STOCK_* env vars override it.
//dataDir: Database, artifacts, variants, trash, backups. The only directory written to.
//mediaDir: Parent of the media roots. Each subdirectory is discovered as a root.
//trustedProxyHops: Reverse proxies of your own in front. 0 trusts no forwarded header.
//castOrigin: Token-only HTTP port a TV fetches cast media from, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8843. Null: same origin.
//secret: JWT and media-URL signing key. Leave null to generate <dataDir>/secret.key.
